Description: Guest enters name, email and password; API validates input and password policy, checks email uniqueness, hashes the password and creates a Customer account.
Guest submits credentials; API verifies them and account status, then issues a JWT and returns safe user info and role (used by the app to show/hide features).
User signs out; app clears local auth state and API revokes the refresh token/session if supported.
Guest submits an email; API returns a generic response and starts a time-limited reset process for an eligible account without disclosing whether the email exists.
Guest submits a valid reset token and new password; API validates both, updates the password hash and invalidates the token.
User submits current and new password; API verifies the current one, validates the new one, updates the hash and applies the session-revocation policy.
App requests the current profile; API resolves identity from JWT claims and returns the allowed fields.
User edits allowed profile fields; API updates only the current user's record. Role/status cannot be changed here.
Customer submits address fields; API validates and creates an address owned by the current Customer.
Customer views the address book; API returns only addresses owned by the current Customer.
Customer edits an address; API verifies ownership and updates it. Historical order address snapshots are not changed.
Customer deletes an address; API verifies ownership and deletes or deactivates it safely without affecting order snapshots.
Admin creates a user with an allowed initial role; API validates email uniqueness and role assignment.
Admin lists/searches users and opens a user record; API returns only permitted fields.
Admin updates permitted user information; API validates (e.g. duplicate email) and saves.
Admin disables an account; API updates status and revokes sessions. The last active Admin cannot be disabled; history is preserved.
Admin assigns an allowed role (Customer/Staff/Admin); API enforces the last-admin safeguard and later authorization reflects the new role.
Actor submits category fields; API validates and rejects duplicate key/name.
Actor views the category list or a category detail.
Actor edits a category; API validates and rejects conflicting unique values.
API deletes the category only if no products reference it; otherwise deactivates or rejects.
Actor submits brand details; API validates and rejects duplicate key/name.
Actor views the brand list or a brand detail.
Actor edits a brand; API validates and rejects conflicting values.
API deletes the brand only if no products reference it; otherwise deactivates or rejects.
Actor submits product details; API validates fields, price and category/brand references, then creates the product in its initial status.

Feature Name: List and view products in admin
Description: Actor lists/searches all products including inactive ones and opens a product detail.
Actor edits permitted fields; API validates price, status and references. Order snapshots stay unchanged.
API deletes the product only if it has no order references; otherwise archives/deactivates so it can no longer be purchased.
Actor adds a size/color/SKU/price variant; API validates the parent product, unique SKU and price.
Actor lists variants of a product or opens one variant.
Actor edits size, color, SKU or price; API validates SKU uniqueness and values. Stock is changed only via inventory adjustment.
API deletes the variant only if safe (stock/order references); otherwise deactivates so it cannot be purchased.
Actor uploads an image or supplies an approved reference; API validates file type/size and links it to the product.
Actor views the images linked to a product with display metadata.

Feature Name: Update image metadata or display order
Description: Actor changes image metadata or display order; API validates and saves.
Actor removes an image; API removes the association and cleans up storage according to policy.
Actor opens the catalog; API returns active public products with pagination.
Actor opens a product; API returns description, images, variants, price and availability.
Actor searches by keyword; API returns matching active products.
Actor filters by category, brand, price range, size and/or color; API validates and combines filters.
Actor picks an allowed sort field and direction; API applies stable sorting with pagination.
Actor views current available quantity for a product or variant.
Actor submits an adjustment quantity and reason; API prevents negative stock and concurrency conflicts and records the movement.
Actor filters stock movements by variant/date and views the audit history.
Customer views their cart; API returns only their items with indicative prices.
Customer adds a variant with a positive quantity; API checks the variant is purchasable and in stock.
Customer changes the quantity; API verifies ownership and availability.
Customer removes an item; API verifies ownership and removes it.
Customer removes all items from their cart (no-op if already empty).
Customer selects address, shipping method and optional coupon; API checks prices, stock and coupon, then returns subtotal, discount, shipping and estimated total. No order is created.
API reloads prices/stock, validates address, coupon and payment method, calculates totals and, in one transaction, creates the order with snapshots, updates stock and records coupon usage.
Customer views a paginated list of their own orders.
Customer opens an order; API checks ownership and returns item snapshots, totals, delivery snapshot, order and payment status.
Customer cancels an order in a cancellable state; API records it and restores inventory exactly once.
Actor searches/filters all orders by ID, status, customer or date.
Actor moves an order to the next status; API validates the transition and payment/inventory conditions and records actor and time.

Feature Name: View payment status for own order
Description: Customer views payment method, amount and status of their own order.
Customer chooses COD or bank transfer; API returns instructions. Payment stays pending and is never marked paid by the client.
Actor verifies the transfer externally and confirms amount/reference; API records confirmer and time once.
Admin defines code, discount, validity period, eligibility and usage limits; API validates and creates the coupon.
Admin lists/searches coupons and opens a coupon detail.
Admin edits coupon fields; API validates code, dates, discount and limits. Existing orders are not affected.
Admin disables the coupon, or deletes it only if it has never been used.
Customer enters a code; API checks status, date window, minimum order, eligible products and usage limits. No usage is consumed.
Customer applies a valid coupon; API recalculates the discount. The coupon is revalidated when the order is placed.
Customer removes the coupon; API recalculates totals without it.
Eligible Customer submits a rating and text; API validates purchase eligibility, rating range and duplicate policy.
Actor views product reviews; public users see only visible reviews, Staff/Admin can see all for moderation.
Mobile Screen: Product Detail, Product Reviews, Admin Panel › Review Moderation

Description: Customer edits the rating/text of their own review; moderation state follows policy.
Customer deletes (or soft-deletes) their own review.
Actor approves, hides or rejects a review; API records the decision and public visibility follows it.
Customer views their own wishlist entries.
Customer adds a product; API prevents duplicate entries.
Customer removes a product from their wishlist.
Admin views order and revenue metrics for a valid period.
Admin views order counts and summaries by date range/status.
Admin views products ranked by the agreed quantity/revenue definition for a period.
